english.title: Burglary dwelling - theft / attempt theft with violence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having entered as a trespasser

(A)_[a dwelling,]_
(B)_[part of a dwelling,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE ADDRESS..),

(C)_[stole therein **(..LIST THE PROPERTY..) to the value of **(..SPECIFY THE VALUE..)]_
(D)_[stole therein **(..LIST THE PROPERTY..) of a value unknown]_
(E)_[attempted to steal therein **(..LIST THE PROPERTY..) to the value of **(..SPECIFY THE VALUE..)]_

when a person within the said building, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), was subjected to

(F)_[violence]_
(G)_[a threat of violence]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(1)(b) of the Theft Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
entered as a trespasser a dwelling/part of a dwelling
stole/attempted to steal and subjected a person to violence of the threat of violence

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Burglary dwelling is normally triable eitherway - however - this offence wording must be used where a burglary in a dwelling involves any person in the dwelling being subjected to violence or the threat of violence, in these specific circumstances the offence is only triable on indictment.
(ii) IMPORTANT - Officers should carefully check an offender's previous convictions. Two prior convictions for domestic burglary may make him/her liable to a minimum sentence of three years imprisonment under the provisions of section 314 of the Sentencing Act 2020.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H1642, H2043, and H2051.
